question: What is included in the service desk?
html:
The service desk is built on HELIX and delivered by our onshore and offshore teams. Over the next 12 months we are making it product-led, with a Tier-0 AI agent and two add-on services. Detailed scope, such as support tiers, hours and response times, is not in the material available to this assistant.

What the desk includes

  • HELIX as the core. The service desk runs on HELIX. Phase 1 of the plan, months 0-12, turns it into a product-led service desk (Frontline growth plan).
  • A Tier-0 AI agent. This is the first point of contact. Its job is to deflect requests before they reach a human analyst (Frontline growth plan).
  • Offshore delivery. Our delivery base includes Goa, Hyderabad and Cape Town (Frontline public filings).
  • Scale. About 1,100 staff as of January 2026, and 900+ law-firm clients as of June 2026 (Frontline public filings; Frontline growth plan).

What is being added

Add-onWho it servesWhy
Cyber-posture subscriptionAM Law baseAttaches to the desk relationship
Legal-AI enablementAM Law baseILTA finds 68% of firms have Copilot, but only 8% have deployed it firm-wide

Source: Frontline growth plan.

Mid-size firms come next, in months 6-18. Our 16-metro screen covers 143 firms with 17,042 attorneys. For 33 of the top 20 ranked firms, the recommended offer is a bundle rather than a single service (Mid-size law firms; Frontline growth plan). The bundle contents are not specified in the data.

What we cannot confirm yet

The context does not cover:

  • Support tiers beyond Tier-0, hours of coverage or response-time targets.
  • Which applications the desk supports, and whether it covers law-firm software.
  • What Tier-0 resolves on its own, and what it hands to people.

A HELIX service catalogue and a ticket-category breakdown would answer these.

Tier-0 deflection and cyber attach are what the plan relies on to lift margin from about 15.4% to about 16.7% (est.) by month 12, and EBITDA growth has to carry the return on a 12-15x entry (est.).

Next actions

  1. Publish a one-page HELIX service catalogue covering tiers, hours, response targets and supported applications.
  2. Pull 12 months of ticket data by category to set a baseline for Tier-0 deflection.
  3. Define the bundle offered to mid-size firms, and show which desk and add-on services it contains.
  4. Track cyber-posture attach rate against the month-12 margin assumption in the growth plan, dated Oct 6, 2026.
